blocks.heading: Subprocessor changes
blocks.body:
We may update this list when we appoint a new subprocessor, replace an existing subprocessor, change the services performed by a subprocessor, or change the principal location from which personal data is processed.

Where required under our Data Processing Agreement, we will provide customers with advance notice of material changes to our subprocessors.

Customers with questions or objections concerning a subprocessor may contact us at dpo@gripable.co.
